title: audit detail session.continued
description: detail of audit rows with action session.continued: the runner handed a session the continuation prompt it writes itself for a turn it interrupted (HOT-28): after a credit pause (cause credit) or a model pause (cause model, ADR-081 sections 4 and 5). The continuation is no new instruction of a person; its turn keeps the acting user of the interrupted turn, named in triggered_by (null when that turn had none, ADR-070). The prompt ID is the continuation's, never its text. Metadata only (02-data-model.md section 2.9); every value is flat (string of printable ASCII up to 256 characters, integer, boolean or null) like the generic detail of api/org-audit.response.json.
